content: Beware. You’re bank may not be ..be able to be added .. since updating I have no way to connect bank .. it’s a 79 a year waste ..  I’ve been a user for years and now it’s a shame ..needs fixing

Used to be great before the ads. The amount of ads that pop up every second is ridiculous, you can’t switch from one page to the next without having to close an ad that pops up over your screen. Such a shame, it’s ADS ADS ADS NONSTOP
Transactions don’t update. Since moving over to [MARCA] my transactions haven’t updated in a week.  They used to update every 24 hours.
Data grabber. Dives straight into reeling your financial goals and details, 0 efforts to understand user needs. Very unpleasant experience.

No Sync Process - Delayed App. The app does sync not update when you manage your budget on the PC. Therefore, you will see the same items you’ve accounted for on the app again, like you’ve never balanced it.
NOT free. Anything worthwhile in this app that would be helpful in budgeting is behind a paywall, I have no idea how this app has such a high rating
Funds are glitchy. Need to be able to turn off funds without deleting categories and need to be able to delete Emergency Fund.

Harassing for premium. I love this app - 5 stars all day. I use the free version and they harass me every time I upload a transaction to upgrade to premium. It is so frustrating that I stopped in the middle of entering transactions to give a bad review. LEAVE ME ALONE.
Not Free. As soon as you sign up, you have to pay

Annoyed. I’ve been trying to set up the “budget” section and it is not letting me get passed the “giving” section. I’m not donating my money to anyone or anything. I put random things in there and it still does not let me move forward.
Please stop making me login!. If you like being forced to login repeatedly, this is the app for you. I’ve had to login three times this month…frustrating. Time to shop for another app.
Budget zero. Why are all my planned budget numbers are seen as zero prior to actually spending the money? When I click on the budget item, then I could see the planned expense or income amount
Macs no longer supported?. I like the app but am really confused as to why I can no longer use or update the app on my Mac. Very strange and upsetting.

This app is not free. I gotta say, I was super frustrated that the monthly subscription for this was so high. My husband and I are trying so desperately to pay off our debt and I got my hopes up after watching so many of his videos talking about paying down debt. I refuse to pay to anything unnecessary. He talks a big talk of people not spending their money when they trying to pay off debt and then charging almost 20$ a month to use his app to pay down their debt.
Confusing Sinking Funds. My finances are in much better order now that I use [APP]. But the Sinking Funds are so confusing.

Stopped working with my bank. This app stopped working with my bank a couple months after I purchased it for the year and customer service said they had no estimated time for a resolution and would give a refund.
Too expensive. Just can’t afford it.
Difficult. Several flaws, but the biggest is that certain purchases take days to show up on this app making it very difficult to track where expenditures are happening.

Disappointed. This app gets great reviews and I hear it talked about on the Ramsey Show so I wanted to try it out.  I installed the app and during the initial setup session I was prompted too many times to upgrade to the premium version and gave up.  I just wanted to use the free version to get a feel for the app but I found then repeated prompts to upgrade annoying, distracting and intrusive.  Additionally the App’s privacy is tracking too much information about me.  I’m just gonna continue using a simple spreadsheet.
Issues. I reset password.  It tells me it’s wrong.   I’ve given up.

It will not open on an apple phone. If you have an iPhone it will log you out regularly.  Then one day without you changing anything it will not allow to log back in because of redirects.  The fix is to turn off all blockers.  And now none of that works and I cannot log in to the app. Very frustrating
Can’t create a budget. I tried to setup a budget three times. Each time I would get a generic something went wrong error, force close, try again and get the same error.

Not the correct features. There’s no way to put in every two weeks income, so I have to calculate it every month when the two weeks will be as most months it’ll be twice a month but sometimes it will be three times a month. Also, there is no way to reconcile credit card payments.
Not for me. Didn’t know you had to pay for this app. That wasn’t disclosed prior to downloading.

Paid version. Transactions take forever to
update. How can I know where I’m at when my transactions are a week behind?

What happened?!. I’m not sure why, but it never stayed connected to my bank and I had to try updating manually, but it didn’t work. I had it in the past and was excited to have it back, but cancelled because somethings wrong.

Buggy and expensive. We’ve used this app for years now. It is consistently buggy in various ways (being locked out of the app, banks disconnecting frequently for no reason, etc.). Most recently, banks don’t integrate correctly, pulling the same transactions multiple times and not pulling h other transactions at all. This makes it impossible to track our budget. Disconnecting and reconnecting banks doesn’t help. After several years using this app every day despite its flaws, we’ve decided it is no longer worth the headache and the price tag.
$$?!. Why on earth would I want to pay a monthly subscription to track expenses when i’m already freaking broke?!?! Stupid money hungry apps

Wasted my time saving my entire budget twice. I just downloaded this app on a new iPhone and spent a good amount of time filling out my expenses and budget for this app to not save it the first time and then the second time, not show correct calculations. So frustrating

Declining accuracy. Accuracy inconvenience is declining over and over again now I have used this app for years and bought for several family members transactions don’t sync until 9 at night the day of posting to your account. You no longer budget in the morning unless you want to be a day late.

I have been using for two years but... I haven’t been able to see any new transactions because my bank account was disconnected. Every time for the past two days I try to reconnect I go through the plaid process and I will get an error saying unexpected error try again. Please fix.

Free version doesn't do anything. I previously started with the free version. It will not allow me to update my planned income now. I've done it multiple times, there is no save function and it reverts to my previous entries. Worthless waste of time
Disappointed. Spent a lot of time creating my budget and learning app. A few days later I open the app and all of the information is gone! I refuse to start over again. Waste of my time.
Transactions not uploading. Transactions aren’t uploading. I’ve tried updating the app and contacting customer service, nothing seems to work. I regret getting this subscription for this useless app

[MARCA]. This is an amazing app other than the [MARCA]. It screws everything up, I hate how the fund part works. Let me erase it or make it where I can link a transaction to it. The automation it has is terrible. I won’t be renewing simply for this one reason. It screws everything up.

Cant even log in. Downloaded app, wont even let me log in. Keeps directing me to the Safari app and tells me it wont do it cuz the page has been redirected too many times. And i already have an account so idk why it just wont let me log in.
Overpriced. Makes a budgeting app but charges you $17 month for premium.

Reconnecting to bank [MARCA]. We have a subscription to the app and have to reconnect it every time we open the app. This app makes it easier to track finances but it’s not worth it having to reconnect it every time.

Background App Refresh….. I’ve submitted several feature requests on the need for background app refresh. I have 19 transactions to allocate and do not see that I have them via a badge notification until I OPEN THE APP?! 
Badges are the life blood of adoption in this distracting world. Let’s go!! 
This has to be a baseline functionality.. once it’s added I’ll bump the app review back to a 5/5.

App missing features on website. The app is missing many features that are on the website. When trying to access the website from a mobile device it says the browser is not compatible. My browser is listed and up to date. Simple thing to fix but they can’t. Not worth spending the money on the subscription.
App Crashes. The app started crashing several months ago. When I try to access the previous month the app crashes and closes. Support has no clue why. No solution.

Why are you forcing us to answer a questionnaire  to keep using the app!?. I’ve been using this app for years. Love it but whatever update just happened now the app is forcing me to fill out a questionnaire before I can continue to use it. NO. There’s no need for me to tell you all my financial goals and more about my overall finances. The budget tool worked just fine without having to provide that.  Add an option to bypass this or sadly, this will be the end of our multi-year relationship.

Disappointed today. Opened app today and there had been an update which now does not allow me to get to the budget without answering a set of questions and there is no way to bypass. I paid for the app to create and track a monthly budget, not to answer your survey in order to do this.
Premium Pitch. Stupid premium pitch every time I open the app I'm so tired of it

New update. I loved the app… but now with this new update it’s throwing off the numbers. 
Normally I plan my next month from the last paycheck of the current month (example last April paycheck used to start May budget) and usually it works. Now when I setup May budget and start putting transactions from in, it shows as if the money isn’t there because the app is not making money “available” until May 1st. It’s throwing off the budget bad and causing my groups to have me in the red. This didn’t happen before the update.

Update sucks. Before the update it could track income and spending. Now it won’t track any income and doesn’t accurately reflect my budget anymore. It just shows what’s spent making it look like I have way less than what’s actually there. 

It’s not as helpful if I can’t also track what’s coming into my budget so I can actually get a real picture of my money.

Terrible update. I’ve used this app for years, but the newest update rounds the monthly expenses to the nearest hundred dollars. There now is no way to see exactly how much I spent in a month, defeating the purpose of a budget app!

New update leading to errors. The new update ruined the remaining to spend category. Now if you go over budget by say $500, it will tell you that you have $500 left to spend, not that you are $500 over

Doesn’t connect to banks. Premium is a scam. I’ve been using this app for literally years (and the biggest advocate) but the last like year or so, it won’t connect to my primary bank. Support just blames my bank and tells me to insert transactions manually “in the meantime” but then when it randomly does connect to my bank, I have all these duplicate transactions - and it’s been going on too long. I tried to get a refund but support tried to sell me on the other “features” of premium which are not helpful to me in any way. The main point of premium is the automatic updated transactions. They also won’t refund me because it was purchased through [MARCA].  Y’all really need to figure this out and stop advertising something you can’t do.

Updating my review of your recent Updates. 1) I would rather NOT have “Merchant” pre-filled in with an editable “category”—instead of leaving it blank for a manual fill-in
2) PLEASE revert/UPDATE [APP] TO—Taping the top of the app TO BRING the user back to the top—the INCOME level of the app. All other apps will do it, [APP] USED TO DO IT, but not in your latest surge of updates!  :-(
3) My bad, could have been a fluke when updating, please disregard!— Now ALL THE BOTTOM TABS are GONE! 😮🙄😵‍💫

Time to go. Latest update caused over 100 duplicate transactions that I am unwilling to go back and fix. I’m done with the lazy testing before deploying updates. Also, I was forced to answer questions before getting to my budget…literally no way to opt out. This app has lost its way. Deleting and moving on after 10 years.

Update fail. In new update, there is no way to login without “starting free trial” or paying. I have used the free version of this app for 11 years. Now I have to go to the website and sign in through the website to access the app. Please change this back.

Not a streamlined experience. The whole point of budgeting at your fingertips is convenience and quick access. I am usually using this when I need to quickly input my expenses and move on. Half the time I’m having to log back in because it’s booted me out and now it tries to make me take this personalize your experience survey before I can even log in. We are researching other options at this point.
Can’t login. Payed $80 a year for an app that I can’t log into

What Happened?. Oh no! What happened? In the latest update, I can’t type in my income received. Can’t get the numbers to type in accurately. I’m punching them on my phone but it’s only recognizing some numbers and not letting me get past a $50 increment. It’s so odd. I've used this app to budget for a while now and never had any issues. Please fix. 🙏
Premium. It’s really annoying being asked to sign up for premium every time I log into the app. Please don’t do this.
Cost to use. Cost to use

Annoyed!. I am very annoyed that now, in order to use the app, my phone has to be updated to a version that it does not support. Which means you people, who think that we shouldn't be spending money, now want me to spend money on a new phone in order to use your app. Ironic? I think so.

UPDATE PROBLEM. The new app does not work for my iPhone. Now I am not able to access my account on Every Dollar.     
I am not HAPPY ABOUT THIS.
App WAS Near Perfect. I split transactions a lot, and now you can’t why did you ruin the app with this update??? Gotta cancel cause it’s unusable now.
Won’t download. Trying even with restarting the phone
Not user friendly. Cannot change the goal without having to use the desktop. Will delete the app.

Incomplete and slow. After many years of using this app, I am still at a loss for why there is not a built-in reconciling feature. Also quite frustrated that this app runs slowly given such a simple design.
Recent update is trash. Can no longer force update to pull in new charges. Please make this a feature again. I like to move charges to the appropriate baskets first thing in the morning.
Not free. Got this to use as a simple check register billed as free. NOT FREE but you don’t find out until you’ve set up an account and given tons of information.

Math ain’t mathing. I have the free version but even the basics don’t work right. You would think that putting money into savings would remove it from your remaining amount to spend. But it doesn’t. For example if I say I’m budgeting 1,000 this month. And I put 100 in savings. It should say I have 900 left to spend. But it still says 1000 in my remaining budget. I hate having to do brain gymnastics for what should be a simple app calculation. And yes I tried doing a transaction to take it out of my “remaining” and put it into “savings”, but it just shows that I spent my savings 😑. For an app claiming to help people get out of debt. You’d think they’d make the savings feature actually work.

No scheduling option 👎. The app does not allow to schedule repeated monthly expenses, they must be manually entered each month. For that reason alone I will not be using this app. Follower of [NOME] for 17 years, but this app falls short
Paid version not worth it. Continually drops bank connections and no refund offered after 30 days. If you download, don’t shell out the $80 to link banks.
Complete Garbage. Spent 15 minutes entering my budget only for it to tell me ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. Very helpful Every Dollar app. Scam artists.

App Doesn’t Work. Got this app for my husband and I and it was working well at first. UNTIL we were looking for a transaction to come up that just didnt show up. We now have to comb through all our transactions and manually add the ones that [APP] misses. Defeats the purpose of making a budget if random transactions don’t appear at all in the app. We contacted support and they said sorry it’s been a month since you’ve paid the subscription - nothing we can do. We deleted and re-added our bank accounts, tried everything we could think of. Also we realized the app gets the totals of the categories wrong sometimes. We did the math ourselves and it added up incorrectly. Again - what’s the point of this app if it’s incorrect?? Would not recommend.

Cost money. So I’m trying to pay off debt and learn to budget. Of course I listen to [NOME], he’s helped me tremendously and I thought I’d download his app as he talks about frequently. Well…it costs money. I’ve been unsubscribed to many subscriptions for a long time…to throw that money toward my two remaining loans. I’m not about to throw even a penny toward another subscription to help me budget to pay down debt quicker…that makes absolutely no sense. I’m disappointed to say the least. And no, I didn’t even attempt to use the app-I stopped right at the “yearly or monthly subscription fee”. I’m sure the app works, but my money toward my debt is more important than this app.

Frustrated and Disappointed. Entered all my information in 3 different times. Every time I come back to the app all my data is gone. Who has time for that?!?! I assume it’s because I’m using the free version. Not much incentive to actually pay for it! So frustrated and disappointed.
Latest Update is Buggy. Can’t open the app with prompting an update after I updated.
Don’t misfile something. Don’t misfile any transactions. If you do, you can’t change it without deleting it.
New update is terrible!. Nothing will load as I’m trying to enter an items on my budget sheet and if it does load, it doesn’t do my updates and it glitches
Recent update. The most recent update is awful!  The font is awful.  The layout and way transactions are saved, is awful!  I don’t love it, at all.
Last update. Last update closed the app and it won’t open

Pod. This app is lame they make you pay for a year automatically if you download it for free and don’t Intend on paying for it. I don’t recommend using it. Now I have on call [MARCA] instead of the people so I can get my money back what a pain

Calculator Keys. Please get rid of the calculator keys - who asked for that??? All I want to do is manually enter my transaction amount. Having to work around a calculator buttons on half my screen with no way to turn off is frustrating. So many unnecessary changes make the app worse, not better.

New Calculator Not User Friendly. Have used the app for a long time and pay for premium. This new calculator update may cause me to unsubscribe. You can’t hold the back button and erase a full number. The typing is slow and requires a done press. Developers should revert back to the one before.

I’m looking for another budget app. How can you possibly keep making this app worse with every update. I’ve had this for at least six years and it consistently keeps getting worse. Who in the heck is in charge? Why do we have to jump through all these hoops to move stuff around and push five different buttons just to put an expense in. And why the heck can I not use the same wording in a different month. Is that really that big of a deal?!
Not functional. App won't open after the new update
App won’t open. The app won’t open and it’s infuriating

Broken. It appears the app updated yesterday and now it will not
Load past a green screen. I use the app everyday. This has never happened. If I delete and reinstall, I’m warned that I’ll lose all my data. I like it otherwise. Please fix this and I will update the review. I
Can find no other
Way to contact you about the problem since the app
Won’t load. I did restart my phone. Thanks!

Please. Fix. The. Badge!. I’ve been complaining about the badge being wrong all the time for the last several updates—for perhaps a year. I can tell you’ve done something but it’s still consistently wrong, just wrong in a different way. Aggravating.

The app is mostly good. But the app badge is really screwed up. It shows that there are transactions to log when there are none or else the number is wrong. If there are any, after I log them, a couple minutes later the badge shows that there 3 new transactions, but there are always none. It does this consistently.

If it shows a number of transactions to log at other times (not the 3 it shows right after I’ve logged all transactions), the number of actual transactions is always one fewer than what the badge indicates.

The badge is almost always wrong now. Completely unreliable.

Irritating. I pay a LOT of money for this service, so please fix.

Difficult to cancel. I attempted to cancel the introductory subscription several times before I was charged for a full year. This app does NOT show under [MARCA] subscriptions. The help feature on the website directs me back to [MARCA] to
cancel! It’s a HUGE contradiction for an app that’s advertised to help
with fiscal responsibility to actually be a subscription trap. Do better, [NOME]!!!!!!

Phone Bill?. I have the free version and I can’t find where to add the phone bill. No option to put dates on bills that I can figure out either. I’m trying to get out of debt so I can’t justify the price tag on the premium version.

Plaid connection is terrible. I use a robinhood credit card and am frequently missing many transactions and occasionally seeing duplicate transactions with the paid version of every dollar. The only reason we paid for premium is for automatic transaction tracking, however the tracking feature barely works. The only way to tell transactions are missing is to manually check every single transaction against your bank statement. Therefore making the automated tracking useless. I contacted support and they told me to manually track my transactions and that I’m not eligible for a refund. Even though the app literally does not do what it promised. Every dollar is trying to pawn off the blame on plaid. [APP], don’t use plaid if it doesn’t work. Figure out how to make it work or don’t offer premium as an option since you can’t deliver on it. DO BETTER DAVE RAMSEY.
Never got on line or called me or wasn’t on zoom. Very disappointing

Terrible, just terrible. I have not  been able to log into my bank accounts for months now using plaid. So I have [NOME] $80 dollars for nothing! I can’t even get a refund. Well played [NOME], well played! Don’t just stay away from this app, run away! I’m not the only person with this problem. [MARCA] it and see how many others have it as well. Please don’t fall for the scam app

Don’t waste your time. It calculate all my expenses wrong, I pay $80 but telling me I pay $28 and then saying I’m over budget but my monthly rent $927 monthly… how I’m over budget ? That rent money keep roof over my head ???

They have ruined it. I will be deleting this app.  They have made recent changes which make it worthless.   Once you are over budget, adding expenses in the past changed the over budget amount.    It no longer does that.   Also, they’ve taken away the ability to see at a glance at the top what you planned, spent and how much is remaining.   You know have to scroll down and it’s not as easy to see at a glance where you stand.    I have no idea why they would make these negative changes, but the app no longer works for me.

Was great, but the budget closing feature ruined everything. I used [APP] for over a year and it helped me so much in managing my finances. However, they just recently added a budget closing feature. While the feature in and of itself is not a bad idea, it completely restructures the app in a way that conflicts with how I’ve used it in the past. I used to be able to edit past budgets and return to them, which I used to keep track of leftover money or determine when I was still owed some. Also, if I was not able to review a previous month’s budget, I could use the new one until I had time to catch up with my finances. I am immensely disappointed by this new update. I hope they change this feature to be optional. If not, I may just need to find a new budgeting app.

Bad changes. I’ve used this app since it was released and have been very happy with it. However this latest update that locks budgets more than two months old completely breaks my workflow. We don’t need you to judge us for when we budget, just give us flexibility to budget when we can. Sometime I get a few months behind but I always catch myself up.  Now I can’t. I’ll have to cancel my subscription and go somewhere else.

Long time disappointed user. The app had been working very well for a long time. It’s been my go to. After this last update. The math isn’t working. Whenever I enter a transaction, it turns it red and tells me that I have that amount remaining instead of taking it off the total for that month or that item this needs to be fixed ASAP.

New update is terrible. The monthly close locks your budget and you cannot edit it. It also carries over leftover budget which is not how I handle my budget! I cancelled my subscription. So sad because I’ve been using it for years. Hopefully they remove the monthly close feature or at least make it optional

Horrible updates. Guys this was such a good app, and I’m very sad that you’ve changed it. I’ve been using it for years but the update is such horrible UI that I’m going to try to get a refund and try a different budget app. 

What changed?

1. Required “budget closing”

This makes the app way too rigid and then messes with your next months budget without an option to turn it off. When you have a month that doesn’t really make sense or you forgot to track, it makes starting over for the next month IMPOSSIBLE and incredibly confusing. I DO NOT want it to “add” money to the next months budget for me. If you want it to be an OPTION, sure, but to make it mandatory is horrible!!

2. Tracked transactions don’t disappear anymore 

This just makes tracking transactions really confusing. Before, when you tracked a transaction it would disappear into a separate folder.  It was satisfying. Now it’s just one long overwhelming list :/

Sad to say I won’t be renewing my every dollar subscription as this features render the app unusable. If they get rid of them, or make them optional, please let me know. Been a regular user of this app since 2022 :(

Update with closing budgets. I don’t like the update that closes the budget on months over 2 months old. It’s very inconvenient for when life gets busy and I need to go back on previous months to reconcile them

They Abruptly Force Closed Prior Months. The owner of this budget management application decided to abruptly force close prior months meaning that one cannot go back and make any changes. This is a terrible mistake that will be costly to them as loyal users will seek an alternative. It doesn’t even make sense. It appears that anything older than the previous month is closed as soon as the first of the month starts. So on November 1st, one couldn’t make any changes to any day in September.

App Good, Horrible Customer Service l. This app is great for budgeting. The customer service is HORRIBLE. It will take them forever to respond to a request and when they do, they don’t answer half of your questions. I’ve been asking for assistance for weeks now on why new features don’t update on my app even though I’m running the most current version.

iPad App. It was an excellent app. But locking access to previous months is a deal breaker. While I understand that there are other apps, I’ve spent years building and maintaining my records on this one. Losing flexibility on this app is means losing years of work. It’s extremely frustrating that such a restrictive feature cannot be disabled.

Decent content; poor app. It’s a good budget tool but has gone downhill. You’re locked out of older months so forget about fixing mistakes. The bank connection doesn’t update daily so you’re left with random updates. BOTH new “features” support admits.

Update runes service I paid for.. A recent update majorly changed the way the app works. Now budgets are permanently locked 30 days after the end of the month. This was applied without warning and now my September budget is locked. Since I was gone most of October, September wasn’t completely finished and now it’s locked that way which cascades the error in to October and all future budgets. This basically ruins the app for me.

Worse, from what I can tell, this change happened with no warning days before the September deadline.

I’ve been paying for this app since 2016. There have been plenty of times where I catch an error beyond the 30 day limit. There have also been months where life gets busy and I fall a month behind. 

I’m not about to pay $80 a year to be bound by such a ridiculous, arbitrary, and micromanaging limit. If it is not changed post haste, I will find an alternative.

New updates screwed it up. Why does the new update close out months?  We had money to spend from some of the months this year and were waiting for a time we needed it. Now I can’t pull up that information. Why is the app making the decision to close months out and now screw up our budgets from earlier this year.

Unannounced changes. I used the every dollar app for years & recently they added a new feature that locks the previous budget months. I had no idea about the change and now I cannot close or reconcile September which is so frustrating. We get paid late sometimes because of being a sub contractor and this new feature is not going to allow us the time needed to finish a month, such a terrible idea with no fix available, support could not even help me re-open the month so I could complete it. Unfortunately we will need to find another app for budgeting.

Month Close Feature. I have been using this app 3 years and I love it. But the newest month close feature that forces your budget closed in two months is absurd. Life happens and you get behind on budgeting, sometimes you find an error and need to go back and change it. Let us lock/unlock the budget. Don’t force it locked and there’s nothing we can do! My budget is way out of wack now I can’t catch up on my transactions and close the budget out myself.

Serious customer service and app issues. My wife has been using every dollar for 10 years. It helped her pay of her student loans, and since getting married it has helped us stay on track with our budget. However, recent issues with the app/site and customer service have caused serious concerns. We upgraded to the paid version, but the inability to integrate with other money institutions online caused compatibility issues that made the feature less than worth the cost. Customer service was not helpful resolving this. Most recently, every dollar decided to close out past months on your behalf, meaning you lose access to all that data. Since a military move and pregnancy this year, we were behind on our budget. My wife put tons of hours into finishing our budget for previous months, only to have Every dollar close out access to those months unannounced. Customer service has blown us off. No love for the people here. No appreciation for faithfulness to the app or company.

Forcibly Closing Past Months. We’ve been religious users of [APP] the past few years and I intentionally leave pas my transactions open to figure things out and now they forcibly LOCK past months so you can’t go back and edit things!!!  They need to change it back.  It would be sad & frustrating, but we will change over to [APP] if this isn’t changed.  This is ridiculous.  Open past months back up please!!!!
Forced change ruined our process. Randomly implemented change to auto-close months, dramatically impacting our process. Terrible decision!

Closed budget ruins the app. This app was ruined when they started closing budgets 2 months back. It’s Nov 5 and I can no longer edit September. I’ve used this app for 6 years and loved it, but if this isn’t fixed I’m going to switch to a different budgeting app. There are times when I discover a mistake I made in a previous month’s budget and need to fix something. I want to be able edit as needed.

Month Close has to go. If this latest update is not reversed, I will be canceling my subscription and finding another budgeting app. Absolutely unacceptable to lock us out of September’s budget on Nov 1st. Thats only 32 days from the last day of September to reconcile your budget.
Closing Budgets. [APP] is already much more restricting than other budgeting apps. They just made it so you can’t edit or track anything in older months. Really not a fan of this change.

Not loving the newest update…. Why add the titles to money spent.   It is annoying and just another “line” to distract.

Live Long Enough to Become the Villain. I have been a loyal, paying annual subscriber of [APP] since 2020. I would let everyone know how [MARCA] and this app specifically helped our family stay on track for budgeting. I’ve even paid for multiple people who saw the annual fee too high of an entry fee.
Life gets really busy sometimes, and even though both me and my wife are on the same page about our budget I’m the one who keeps track (the nerd). And sometimes I fall behind, but that’s ok because I know where I left off and I know where we’re at. I’m able to go back and make all my changes to our budget.
But a recent unannounced update has severely degraded the app’s usability for how we budget.
[APP] recently rolled out a forced "Month Close" feature that automatically locks budgets that are more than two months old. There was absolutely no advance warning, email notice, or in-app countdown before this went live. If you are someone who reconciles transactions or adjusts budgets every few weeks or months, you will suddenly find yourself completely locked out of editing your OWN historical data.
When you pay for a full year upfront, you expect feature stability. Forcing a massive structural change that alters how users interact with their financial data—without an option to toggle it off—is incredibly disappointing. 
I have reached out to support multiple times regarding this issue to no avail.
If you need flexibility in your budgeting tool and want control over your past data, I highly recommend looking elsewhere before locking yourself into a yearly subscription here.
If [APP] changes this to be an optional feature my review will absolutely amend this review and will renew my annual subscription.
